import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { oauthAccessTokens } from "../../../backend/schema/oauth_access_tokens";

export const oauthAccessTokensCms = customizeTable<typeof oauthAccessTokens>("oauth_access_tokens", {
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    display: {
        title: "token"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "token", "refreshToken", "revokedAt", "scopes", "previousRefreshToken"],
    fields: {
        token: {
            multiline: true
        },
        refreshToken: {
            multiline: true
        },
        scopes: {
            multiline: true
        },
        previousRefreshToken: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "token",
        "refreshToken",
        "revokedAt",
        "scopes",
        "previousRefreshToken",
        "expiresIn",
        "resourceOwner",
        "application",
        "createdAt"
    ]
});
